market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (LOW) $70 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$96. Need ~27% drop to $70 by end-June. A US-Iran peace deal that ends the Hormuz crisis could rapidly de-risk prices toward pre-war $72 area, but ceasefires keep failing. Two months is meaningful runway; estimate ~20%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Pace of Iran-US diplomacy and Hormuz reopening
